An employer, other than a small business, shall report 6 annually to the department of workforce development, in a time 7 and manner established by the department, how the employer 8 used any savings received by the employer as a result of this 9 Act for the purposes provided in subsection 1 in the previous 10 calendar year. The report shall include quantified data on the 11 use of such savings. For purposes of this subsection, “small 12 business” means any enterprise that is operated for profit 13 and under a single management, and that has either fewer than 14 twenty employees or an annual gross income of less than four 15 million dollars computed as the average of the three preceding 16 fiscal years. > 17 ______________________________ GOSA of Scott -1- HF 980.1744 (3) 91 je/js 1/ 1 #1. #2. #3. #4.
